description: This file contains multiple GTK dialog classes for a GUI application, including AboutDialog, SystemInformationDialog, AddLabelDialog, and LuksPassphraseDialog, used for displaying system info, adding disk labels, and entering passphrases.

classes.name: AboutDialog
classes.description: Dialog for displaying 'about' information of the application

classes.name: SystemInformationDialog
classes.description: Dialog showing system and application version info, startup options, and warnings

classes.name: AddLabelDialog
classes.description: Dialog for adding a disk label to a disk

classes.name: LuksPassphraseDialog
classes.description: Dialog for entering a passphrase to decrypt a disk

methods.name: set_decorated
methods.description: Set whether the dialog window has window decorations

methods.name: run
methods.description: Display the dialog and return user input or None
